julebord.om: For the office Christmas party, the holiday pre-game and the Santa party. Safe to play with coworkers – but never boring.

items.t: Whoever has been at the company the longest gives out three sips.
Everyone who has sent an email starting with “Hi all” this year, drink.
Point at the person most likely to still be sitting there when the afterparty is over.
Everyone who has forgotten a Teams meeting this year, drink one.
Say who here you'd bring to a desert island – and why. The person you pick drinks.
Cheers to the person who carries the most work without ever getting credit for it.
Everyone who has wrapped a present with tape and a guilty conscience, drink.
Whoever has the longest trip home tonight makes the next rule.
Sing the first line of a Christmas song. Can't do it? Drink two.
Point at the person with the best Christmas sweater tonight. The winner gives out three.
Everyone who has already had Christmas dinner this year, drink one.
New rule: Anyone who says “work” for the rest of the round drinks.
Tell us your most embarrassing work moment this year – or drink three.
Everyone who has signed off with “Kind regards” and meant it passive-aggressively, drink.
Point at the person most likely to give a speech nobody asked for.
The youngest person in the room gives out two sips. The oldest drinks one.
Everyone who has said “let's take this offline” in a meeting this year, drink.
Name three Christmas movies in five seconds – or drink two.
Cheers to the boss. If the boss is here, the boss drinks two.
Everyone who asked for something practical for Christmas, drink. Boring!
Point at the person with the messiest desk.
Whoever has taken the most days off this year drinks one and explains themselves.
Everyone who has chased a bus this week, drink.
New rule: Everyone has to say “Merry Christmas” before they drink. Forget it and drink another.
Say something nice about the person on your left. If it gets too nice, you both drink.
Everyone who has fallen asleep on the couch after work this week, drink.
Point at the person most likely to play Santa next year.
Guess how many people in the room have bought all their Christmas presents. Off by more than two? Drink.
Everyone who has called in sick on a Monday, drink. No one's asking why.
Cheers to the canteen – or to whoever always brings cake.
Whoever has the most unread emails drinks one per thousand.
Say what you really thought of this year's summer party – or drink two.
Everyone who has said “this'll only take five minutes” and it took an hour, drink.
Point at the person who would win a quiz about the company.
Impersonate a coworker (nicely!) until the table guesses who. No correct guess in three tries? Drink.
Everyone who put up Christmas decorations before December 1st, drink one.
Whoever is sitting closest to the door gives out two sips.
New rule: No one can say anyone's name for the rest of the round. Say a name, drink.
Everyone who has regifted a present, drink. Recycling is good for the planet.
Cheers to everyone who didn't come tonight. They're missing out on this.
Say which coworker you'd swap jobs with for a day. They drink one.
Everyone who has worked from home in sweatpants this year, drink.
Point at the person most likely to be the boss in ten years.
Finish the sentence: “Next year I'm going to …”. Everyone votes on whether it's believable. No = drink.
Everyone who has watched “Home Alone” this year, drink. Everyone else drinks too – for tradition's sake.
Cheers to the year that's been. Everyone drinks!

vill.om: For the crew who know each other well and can handle almost anything. 18+.

items.t: Everyone who has texted an ex after midnight, drink two.
Show the last photo in your camera roll – or drink three.
Point at the person most likely to end up in a jail cell tonight. Whoever gets the most fingers drinks.
Tell us about the worst date you've ever been on. Whoever has the worst one gives out four.
Everyone who has lied about their age, drink.
The person to your right gets to read your last three messages out loud. Refuse: drink four.
New rule: Everyone has to drink with their other hand. Forget and drink another.
Everyone who has woken up with no idea where they were, drink two.
Point at the person with the worst ideas at 3 a.m.
Say who in the room you think has the most secrets. They can reveal one or drink three.
Everyone who has been kicked out of a bar or club, drink.
Call or send a voice message to your last match and say “have a nice weekend”. Or drink five.
Whoever has been single the longest gives out three sips.
Everyone who has ghosted someone, drink. Whoever has been ghosted the most gives out two.
Point at the person most likely to get married in Las Vegas.
Tell us the dumbest thing you've done while drunk. The group votes: boring = drink three.
New rule: Anyone who laughs, drinks. Lasts until the next rule card.
Everyone who has stalked their ex's new partner on social media, drink two.
Let the group pick an emoji reply you have to send to the last person you talked to. Or drink four.
Point at the person with the most screenshots of other people's messages.
Everyone who has said “I'm not drinking tonight” and then did anyway, drink.
Share your most unpopular opinion. If everyone disagrees, you give out three.
The person with the lowest battery has to hand their phone to their neighbour for one minute. Or drink four.
Everyone who has kissed someone in this room, drink. No questions asked.
Point at the person most likely to be drunk first tonight. They start now.
Whoever has stayed the longest at an afterparty tells us how it ended – or drinks three.
New rule: Every toast is now “yeehaw”. Say “cheers” and drink two.
Everyone who has taken a taxi they couldn't afford, drink.
Do your best impression of someone in the group. If they guess wrong, drink three.
Point at the person who always says “just one more”.
Everyone who has lied in their dating app bio, drink.
Say who in the group you think talks about you the most. They drink if they admit it, you drink if they deny it.
Whoever has the most unanswered texts from mom drinks one per text (max five).
Swap seats with the person you've talked to the least tonight. Whoever refuses drinks three.
Point at the person who would survive the longest on Love Island.
Everyone who has fallen asleep somewhere random after a party, drink two.
Tell us about a time you got caught in a lie. The group votes on whether it was good enough – no = drink.
New rule: Everyone has to talk in a fake accent until the next rule card. Slip up, drink.
Everyone who has sent a text to the wrong person, drink. If it was embarrassing, drink two.
Pick a drinking buddy. Every time you drink for the rest of the round, they drink too.
Point at the person most likely to end up on TV.
Whoever has the highest screen time this week shows the number – or drinks four.
Everyone who has been dumped over text gives out two. You've suffered enough.
Tell us who your secret crush was in middle school – or drink three.
Waterfall! Everyone starts drinking, and no one stops until the person to their right has stopped.
Cheers to all the bad decisions that turned into good stories.
